headlines.title: The Trump administration's move to end subsidies for Medicare drug plans could cost consumers
headlines.summary: Federal subsidies that have helped defray insurers' Medicare drug costs will disappear at the end of the year. Millions of beneficiaries could face higher premiums in 2027.

headlines.title: Oregon is on track for its worst wildfire season yet
headlines.summary: Wildfires in central and eastern Oregon are prompting evacuations and forcing ranchers to scramble to move cattle and find feed as public range land burns. More than a million acres have burned so far. Most fires have little or no containment.

headlines.title: 'Taiwan Travelogue' rethinks history, colonialism, and identity
headlines.summary: The author and translator of Taiwan Travelogue, the winner of the 2026 International Booker Prize, discuss identity and history amid the debate over Taiwan's colonial ties to Japan and escalating geopolitical pressure from China.

headlines.title: 'Odyssey' translator Emily Wilson says Nolan shouldn't have written the movie himself
headlines.summary: The renowned classics scholar caused a stir when her critical review of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey went viral. Wilson explains her reaction to the film and why she's translating the poem again.

headlines.title: High heat tests trade barriers
headlines.summary: Europe and North America are once again sweltering under intense heat waves, underscoring the urgency of accelerating the green transition. But some governments have erected trade barriers against China's renewable energy technologies and products under the banner of "de-risking".

headlines.title: Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment at Senate hearing on COVID-19 response
headlines.summary: Anthony Fauci, the former US government's top infectious disease official, repeatedly invoked his Fifth Amendment right against self-incrimination during a Senate hearing on Wednesday, declining to answer lawmakers' questions about his handling of the COVID-19 pandemic.

headlines.title: Saudis confirm joint strikes with US
headlines.summary: Days of relative calm in the Middle East region were shattered when Saudi Arabia confirmed joint strikes with the United States against "Iran-aligned terrorist militias" in Iraq, citing "self-defense" after the kingdom's oil facilities were attacked.

headlines.title: Japan hit by aftershocks as homes go without power
headlines.summary: Emergency workers combed through collapsed houses looking for survivors after a powerful earthquake that killed 14 people in Japan's Kumamoto Prefecture, Kyodo News reported on Wednesday.

headlines.title: China boosting global stability amid volatility
headlines.summary: A new pattern is in the making in the midst of intense turbulence in the international situation, and China is making fresh, important contributions to building a new type of international relations, according to an annual flagship publication released by Beijing-based think tank China Institute of International Studies.

headlines.title: Farmer, worker groups to intensify protests against Centre’s policies
headlines.summary: Farmers and workers unite to escalate protests against the government's labor and agricultural policies amid ongoing economic and social crises.

headlines.title: Centre’s assurance cannot override statutory processes governing withdrawal of FIRs, experts say
headlines.summary: Legal experts assert that the Centre's assurance cannot override statutory processes for FIR withdrawals amid ongoing investigations.

headlines.title: Rahul Gandhi demands Amit Shah’s resignation over police brutality during Delhi protests
headlines.summary: Rahul Gandhi accuses Amit Shah of police brutality against Delhi student protesters and defends his right to speak in Parliament.

headlines.title: Govt. simplifies NEET-UG 2026 counselling process
headlines.summary: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda reviews NEET UG counselling 2026, highlighting new reforms for transparency and accessibility in admissions.

headlines.title: Bankipur byelection: Polling begins as all eyes on contest between Prashant Kishor and BJP’s Neeraj Kumar Sinha
headlines.summary: Polling begins in Bihar's Bankipur byelection, featuring Prashant Kishor and 25 candidates, with vote counting on August 3.

headlines.title: China warns of retaliation if US sticks with robot ban
headlines.summary: China will "resolutely retaliate" and safeguard ​its interests if the United ‌States insists on acting unilaterally over an import ban on new Chinese robots and ​power inverters, the commerce ministry ​said on Thursday.

headlines.title: Samsung sees chip shortage extending to 2028, signs long-term supply deals
headlines.summary: Samsung Electronics said on ​Thursday it expects chip shortages to worsen and extend into 2028, after it posted a more than 250-fold jump in chip profit, ‌countering investor concerns that feverish AI spending by major technology firms may slow and curb growth.

headlines.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 13; Poland scrambles fighter jets
headlines.summary: Russian air strikes killed ​at least 13 in Ukraine on Thursday, including one in Kyiv, in attacks extending as far as the western city of Lviv, forcing ‌neighbouring Poland to scramble fighter jets to secure its airspace.

headlines.title: Australia begins legal action against Telegram over alleged pro-terror material
headlines.summary: Australia's internet regulator said on Thursday it had begun legal action against ​messaging platform Telegram over alleged failings to tackle pro-terror posts.

headlines.title: EXCLUSIVE: Intel providing chip technology to startup led by co-investor of Tan in rare deal
headlines.summary: Intel has provided access to some of its processor technology to ‌a new startup, according to a source and documents reviewed by Reuters, in a rare move for the U.S. chipmaker.

hackerNews.title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
hackerNews.summary: One day there will hopefully be a house on this land Over the last year, I admittedly haven’t used my Vision Pro a ton, but fairly recently I discovered a super handy use that it’s absolutely incredible at, provided you have the right tools. After years of apartment life my girlfriend and I have recently begun the process of building our (first! exciting!) home, which is an absolute whirlwind of choices and decisions. Maybe it’s where we’re both programmers, but particularly for me, my software-oriented brain feels almost incompatible with this world of designing a home (she’s the main one keeping this project moving forward).
